fixed.why: The English ends with "Nothing is sent." and the Tamil had no such sentence (the English was extended on 2026-11-14 and the Tamil was not). A lost "nothing is sent" on the offer draft screen is a safety-relevant omission.

fixed.why: A spelling error: "செய்தாகக்" is not a valid form (it must be "செய்ததாகக்", "that you did it"). It is the line a patient reads under a checklist item they marked done.

The same word means "escalation" everywhere else in the console (உயர்நிலைக்கு அனுப்பு..., "sent to a higher level"); this string used உயர்த்தல் ("raising"), so the same idea read as two different things on a safety-related screen.
